text:
maria_cs: Thalesys (finance) requests a short demo uplift next Wed. Needs EU + LATAM capacity + header allowlist because IPs rotate.
jamal_support: What's target QPS & windows?
maria_cs: ~250 sustained, 350 peak; window 2026-04-14 15:00-19:00 UTC.
ae_sam: This demo is tied to renewal - please prioritize.
devon_eng: Recommend header pin, route to eu-west-1 + sa-east-1, pin model to v2-small, pre-warm KV cache 30m prior.
karen_oncall: Canary 10% for 10m, autorevert at 72h, alerts: >1% 5xx or p50>200ms. Page on breach.
jamal_support: Draft override:
POST /v1/overrides {customer:thalesys, regions:[eu-west-1,sa-east-1], allowlist:{type:header,name:x-thalesys-demo,value:demo-0426}, rate_override:{qps:350,burst:600}, duration:72h, autorevert:true}
jamal_support: Applying to staging canary now.
deploy-bot: change-request 1769004321: applying canary (10%).
deploy-bot: change-success 1769004350: staging canary healthy.
jamal_support: Rolling to prod; TTL allowlist 7d; autorevert scheduled.
deploy-bot: change-success 1769004380: prod override applied to eu-west-1 & sa-east-1. Smoke passed.
maria_cs: Added runbook link for AE and renewal note.
karen_oncall: Runbook: https://playbooks.internal/demo-thalesys.
maria_cs: I'll follow up for header value and warmup prompts. Closing when AE confirms outcome. :thumbsup:
